✅ DAGs, Lineage, Shuffling & Partitioning

✅ Broadcast joins, skew mitigation, salting
✅ Real-world examples, commands, and interview Q&As

✅ Spark Submit, Cluster Modes, Deployment Best Practices

ai_analysis.summary: This is a promotional post for a self-made PySpark guide, not the guide's technical content itself. The author lists intended coverage of PySpark architecture, SparkContext, SparkSession, RDDs, DataFrames, Datasets, DAGs, lineage, shuffling, partitioning, caching, persistence, repartitioning, coalescing, broadcast joins, skew mitigation, salting, file formats, schema handling, performance tuning, Spark Submit, cluster modes, and deployment practices. Although the post mentions real-world examples, commands, and interview questions and answers, none of that material is included here.
